text:
frank: Quick follow-up from the small canary that tripped this morning. We reverted manually but we should avoid manual reroutes next time. Need: deploy-time guardrail, controller rollback wiring, and a short smoke gate.

frank: Root cause: rollout=5% + auto_rollback=false. Monitoring fired but controller not subscribed.

maya: I'll take the controller wiring. Plan: subscribe to alertstream, evaluate simple rollback rules, flip flag and attach audit note. POC in 3 business days.

ike: I'll add a deploy-bot preflight: block rollout>1% unless auto_rollback=true or a two-owner override is recorded. Can push to staging tonight.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: logged deploy job=ci/7201 rollout=5 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

frank: Suggested rollback rule (pseudo):
```
rollback_rules:
  - metric: service.p99_ms
    op: ">="
    value: 250
    window: 3m
    action: rollback
```

maya: When controller flips, it will append incident link + snapshot of rollout percent for audit.

ike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/p/deploy-bot/pull/402 (preflight + two-owner override).

frank: Action items + deadlines:
- maya: controller POC -> +3 bd -> 1932450000
- ike: deploy-bot preflight -> tomorrow AM -> 1932200000
- infra: canary-smoke job template -> +2 bd -> 1932350000

frank: Drop :white_check_mark: and PR/ticket links here when done. I'll add owners to the postmortem ticket and close out. If blocked, @eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
